order: Re-open the WO-11 quartermaster review for a second round and fix every finding the round-1 pass left open. analyze() must re-validate a recorded confirmation against live evidence at every call — evidence timestamp match, live predicate, no fresh throttle, not exhausted, no malformed-latest poison — instead of honoring a confirmation simply because it falls inside the freshness window. confirm() refuses and appends nothing when the bucket is freshly throttled, exhausted, or its latest raw line is malformed, and never blind-grants through any of the three. Every public entry point validates forecast, maxFreshMs, and maxStaleMs as finite numbers and throws rather than silently coercing a string. Re-rule finding D1 in full against the reviewer's verbatim round-2 text — keep the round-1 text struck through, not deleted — and restore F-1's dropped substance as its own line. Correct the status summary's quick-start claim and the incident-2 attestation so the record shows the true, exercised outcome; no other change is made.
claims: We added 33 checks across four new adversarial sections, bringing the suite from 154 to 187 — verified failing against the pre-fix implementation (29 failures, including the critical exploit dispatching instead of gating and a live range error out of predictThrottle), then verified all green after the fix. D1 was re-ruled against the reviewer's verbatim text, the incident-2 record reconciled against its sibling report, and every count and attribution nit across the WO-11 record and role docs was resolved.
